questions.title: Jobs
questions.hint: Anything people do for a living.
rules: Any real job or profession counts.
Kinds of one job are separate answers: nurse and midwife.
Different names for one thing count once.

questions.title: SN words
questions.prompt: Name a word that starts with SN
rules: Any real English word that starts with SN.
Forms of one word count once: the plural, and verb forms like -ed and -ing.
Names of people, places and brands don't count.
